errors.text_span: Dazwischen reihen sich absteigend die Balken für „Deutschland“ (ca. 71 %), „Dänemark“ (ca. 70 %), „Japan“ (ca. 69 %), „Vereinigtes Königreich“ (ca. 61 %), „Südkorea“ (ca. 60 %), „USA“ (ca. 59 %), „Frankreich“ (ca. 57 %) und „Spanien“ (ca. 53 %) ein.
errors.evidence: This sentence presents a list of bars in what it claims is descending order. However, it omits the bars for 'EU27' and 'OECD' from this list, even though they fall within the sequence. For example, it jumps from 'USA' (59%) to 'Frankreich' (57%), skipping 'EU27' (58%). This makes the description of the sequence confusing because the list is not a continuous descending series from the chart, and the omitted bars are described separately later.
